evals.prompt: Find open-access doctoral theses about the Ming dynasty.
evals.expected_output: search '"Ming dynasty"' with instanceType "Doctoral thesis" and accessRightLabel "Open Access"
expectations: The OpenAIRE Graph API (api.openaire.eu/graph) was queried
The instance type filter "Doctoral thesis" was used, with quotes
Open-access links (repository URLs) are given for each thesis

evals.expected_output: find_doi / pid lookup, then list copies with access OPEN
expectations: The DOI was looked up with the pid parameter

The 明代科舉《春秋》義題目資料庫 dataset or the 明代研究 article is listed
